headline: TSMC Plans Massive Arizona Expansion with 12 New Fabs, Reshaping Global Chip Manufacturing
summary: This colossal investment signals a strategic pivot by the world's leading chipmaker to diversify advanced semiconductor production outside Taiwan, significantly boosting US domestic capacity. headline: U.S. House bill introduced to ban sale of key AI chipmaking equipment to China, escalating tech trade war.
